members.definition_stripped_target: Across independently calibrated protocols applied to a controlled family of closed-boundary manufactured artifacts, boundary-traversal/profile data, enclosed-measure readouts, swept-transfer composition and gravimetric capacity must be jointly coherent within their own scale/tolerance envelopes.
members.why_independent: Uses dimensional/profile imaging, wrap-length, optical area, piston-flow and gravimetric-capacity channels. Their explicit π factors share classical geometry, but the measurements are not the same apparatus or the same observable.
members.deletion_witness: Deleting KENG-01 allows a candidate to explain cyclic, diffusive and modal behavior while failing the cross-observable coherence that makes classical round-geometry compression operationally useful.
forbidden_native_shortcuts: classical π or its numerical value
members.scale_tolerance_summary: Must cover the declared dimensional/aperture/flow/capacity protocol ranges; in particular retain the cited aperture high-accuracy scale, piston-flow ~0.003-2 L/s with ~0.044%-0.064% expanded uncertainty, and gravimetric capacity ~3.8-7600 L with source-specific expanded uncertainty.

members.definition_stripped_target: Finite repeatable cycles close within measured error, and relative time/fractional-cycle displacement and drift behave consistently across mechanical indexing and electronic signal protocols.
members.why_independent: Mechanical indexing and electronic phase comparison are distinct apparatus and measurement chains; their shared 2π representation is stripped to a recurrence/fractional-displacement constraint.
members.deletion_witness: Deleting KENG-02 permits a candidate with correct geometry, diffusion and bounded spectra but no account of repeatable cycle closure or phase/frequency drift.
forbidden_native_shortcuts: classical π or its numerical value
members.scale_tolerance_summary: Must span at least one mechanical full-cycle indexing protocol and the cited low-frequency electronic phase range (~1 Hz-100 kHz depending system), each within its calibration uncertainty.

members.definition_stripped_target: A localized controlled perturbation produces reproducible material/scale-dependent relaxation or spreading over time, with conservation/transport and error behavior matching the declared experiment without requiring a Gaussian integral-normalization constant.
members.why_independent: Thermal transient measurements are neither cycle-closure nor boundary-mode measurements; Gaussian π enters only in one continuum representation of the response.
members.deletion_witness: Deleting KENG-03 permits a candidate to explain static/periodic/modal successes while failing transport, spreading and scale-time relaxation.
forbidden_native_shortcuts: classical π or its numerical value
members.scale_tolerance_summary: Must reproduce the declared laser-flash specimen/material regimes and experiment-specific thermal-response uncertainty; no universal Gaussian normalization tolerance is admissible.

members.definition_stripped_target: A bounded propagation apparatus exhibits discrete reproducible resonances whose shifts track controlled apparatus/material state, with independent acoustic and microwave channels agreeing on common state changes within their uncertainty envelopes.
members.why_independent: This uses bounded-wave resonance and cross-channel mode tracking, not direct cycle timing, diffusion relaxation or static manufactured-boundary measure.
members.deletion_witness: Deleting KENG-04 permits a candidate to explain closure, transport and static measure while failing discrete bounded spectra and cross-channel resonance shifts.
forbidden_native_shortcuts: continuum wave equation as native premise
classical π or its numerical value
members.scale_tolerance_summary: Must meet the cited resonator regimes with ppm/sub-ppm fractional-frequency envelopes (roughly 0.2×10^-6 to several ×10^-6 depending system/temperature).

minimality_witness.cover_requirement: Cover every audited dependency-quotient class that retains an independent π-success explanatory pressure after definition/convention stripping.
minimality_witness.excluded_class: Q03_FOURIER_SPECTRAL_NORMALIZATION_DESCENDANTS is removed as π-specific pressure because convention conversion removes its π placement.
minimality_witness.why_not_three: Any 3-member subset omits exactly one of the four surviving residual pressure types; it may satisfy the taskbook's bare 'at least three protocol families' condition but does not explain the full audited residual surface, so it is not a cover-minimal K_eng for this atlas.
minimality_witness.uniqueness: No universal uniqueness claim. K_eng is minimal relative to the audited rows, stripping rules and primary-dependency partition; later evidence may refine or split members.

one_number_fit_policy: REJECTED: numerical proximity of any native readout to the classical decimal expansion of π is neither necessary nor sufficient for K_eng coverage.

explanatory_compression_future_protocol.formula: explained independent K_eng members / (native assumptions + imported effective definitions)
